subject: Dedicated capacity — annualized tranche plan and true-up questions
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia@olympusai.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity inquiry — 3yr prepay with staged uptake

Vanessa,

Thanks for the earlier demo — Olympus AI is evaluating Dedicated for production inference (customer-facing chat & embed store). We're looking at committing to a multi-year prepay but prefer an annualized tranche approach rather than a single big upfront: 

- High level ask: 3-year commitment with annual prepay and the option to true-up once per year.
- Expected baseline usage (rough): Year 1 peak 40 GPUs equivalent, Year 2 peak 85, Year 3 peak 130. We expect burst traffic but want guaranteed baseline capacity.
- Important: price protection across the 3 year term, and a clear mechanism for early expansion credits.

Can you share a proposal outlining (a) discount tiers for multi-year annualized prepay, (b) a ramp/tranche schedule that supports true-ups, and (c) any carve-outs for burst vs. baseline? Procurement wants to see an example SOW and a sample invoice cadence.

Attached a short usage snapshot and our current cost model.

Cheers,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Infrastructure
Olympus AI

Attachment: Olympus-usage-profiles.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28KB)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@olympusai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity inquiry — 3yr prepay with staged uptake

Alicia — thanks for the context and the usage snapshot. Forwarding a first-draft commercial proposal attached (Redwood-Dedicated-Offer-v3.pdf) that follows an annualized tranche structure. Highlights in this draft: 

- Annual prepay tranches: you purchase "prepaid capacity units" each year (you can true-up within a 60-day window after year-end).
- Discount cadence: tiered term discount (Year 1 baseline discount, additional uplift discounts for year-level CV commitments), plus a fixed expansion credit if you add more capacity mid-term.
- Burst capacity: guaranteed baseline with a separate short-term burst pool billed at a lower overage rate (we keep burst price predictable).
- Invoice cadence and PO flow: annual invoice at tranche start with a true-up invoice if consumption exceeds prepaid units.

Two items I need from you to finalize pricing: (1) target committed baseline per year (we can accept ranges) and (2) preferred true-up window (your note said once per year; we usually support 60–90 days).

If this looks directionally right we'll loop in Legal and Solutions for a SOW and DocuSign route.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive 
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-Dedicated-Offer-v3.pdf (proposal, 112KB)

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia@olympusai.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity inquiry — 3yr prepay with staged uptake

Vanessa,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from procurement and infra: 

- True-up window: need 90 days to reconcile usage and sync with our fiscal calendar — can you support 90 days instead of 60?
- Expansion credit: ask that any mid-year expansions (add-on tranches) receive at least a 10% credit on the incremental units for the remainder of the term.
- Price protection: we need a contract clause preventing upward price resets for the committed units during the 3-year term (exceptions for tax/regulatory changes).

If you can bake these into the proposal, Procurement will push for a PO + initial payment within 30 days of signature. Also, please add an example line-item invoice so we can map to our AP system.

Thanks — Alicia

On a separate note, is there a simple way to get a short SLA note showing latency targets per GPU tier? Our SREs will want that in the SOW.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity inquiry — commercial counterproposal notes

Vanessa/Rishi — looped in with some suggested commercial language to cover Alicia's asks. Draft bullets below (I recommend we keep this as an "annualized tranche" product name in the contract):

- True-up window: agree to 90 days post-anniversary for a single-year reconciliation; invoice or credit issued after reconciliation.
- Expansion credit: incremental capacity added mid-term receives a 10% SKU credit (applied pro-rata for remaining months in term).
- Price protection: fixed unit price for prepaid capacity for the full 36 months; allowed adjustments only for explicit changes in tax or sanctioned regulation.
- Burst carve-out: baseline prepaid units guarantee capacity; temporary burst pool available with a capped overage rate (we propose 0.4x of published on-demand TPM rate).
- SLA/latency: include an appendix with per-tier median p95 latency targets (we'll have Solutions scope this; put a placeholder in the SOW).
- Invoice cadence & PO: annual invoice at tranche start; true-up invoice within 90 days of anniversary if usage > prepaid units.

Pricing mechanics (proposal): 
- Yearly committed tranche bands: 32–64 units, 65–96 units, 97–160 units. 
- Multi-year discount: 8% off published Dedicated list for Year 1 tranche, additional 4% on Year 2 and 3 if paid annually and committed; we can layer an expansion credit for early sign (up to 6%).
- Early termination: standard early-termination amortization; propose 6-month notice for churn with pro-rata refunds on unused prepaid months beyond the 6-month window.

Rishi — want to confirm the discount stack and whether we can offer a 10% upfront credit if Olympus signs within 14 days (to accelerate close).

-M

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity inquiry — commercial counterproposal notes

Marissa — thanks, this is a clean layout. I support the 90-day true-up and the 10% expansion credit. A few adjustments to reduce long-term exposure: 

- Discount stack tweak: make Year 1 discount 6%, Year 2 and 3 add-ons bring total to 10% if they stay committed (this lowers immediate concession).
- Fast-sign incentive: 5% credit applied to first invoice if signed within 14 days; avoid layering with other credits.
- Bursts: allow 30% burst headroom above baseline for free for first 6 months after go-live (encourages initial migration), thereafter billed at capped overage.

If that looks good I'll sign off and we can update the PDF and generate a DocuSign route.

-Rishi
